# Singapore secondary schools: expanded school-choice database

**Cut-offs, opportunities beyond academics, practical considerations and published O-Level outcomes.**

This is a self-contained expansion of the earlier Markdown database. It retains all **147 schools, 899 original cut-off records and 39 affiliation links**, and adds a student-fit profile for every school and a two-year O-Level publication audit. Import the canonical JSON at the end as your app database; readable sections explain its contents and limits.

## 1. Scope and the meaning of the years

Research date: **24 November 2026, Singapore time**. Non-academic offerings are a current-source snapshot, not a guarantee of 2027 availability. The O-Level outcomes refer to the **2024 and 2025 examinations**, released on **10 January 2025** and **14 January 2026** respectively. The 2026 examination results are not yet available at this date. [2024 SEAB release](https://www.seab.gov.sg/newsroom/release-of-2024-singapore-cambridge-gce-o-level-exam-results/) · [2025 SEAB release](https://www.seab.gov.sg/newsroom/release-of-2025-singapore-cambridge-gce-ordinary-level-examination-results/) · [SEAB examination dates](https://www.seab.gov.sg/important-dates-for-candidates/)

| Data | 2024 means | 2025 means |
|---|---|---|
| Cut-off records | 2024 posting exercise, for S1 entry in 2025 | 2025 posting exercise, for S1 entry in 2026 |
| O-Level outcomes | Examination taken in 2024; results released in 2025 | Examination taken in 2025; results released in 2026 |

From 2027 the **Singapore–Cambridge Secondary Education Certificate (SEC)** replaces N(T)-, N(A)- and O-Level qualifications. A current P6 child’s mainstream pathway should therefore be described using the SEC and subject levels G1/G2/G3, while the older examination names remain correct for these historical outcomes. IP and specialised school pathways remain distinct. [SEAB SEC information](https://www.seab.gov.sg/secondary-education-certificate-sec/)

**Coverage is complete across the 147-school universe and the 294 school/year audit slots. Numerical publication is incomplete:** a figure is supplied only where the research located usable year-specific evidence. Missing figures do not mean poor results, and an unsuccessful search is not proof that a school has never published the information.

## 2. How “pros” and “cons” are grounded

- **Documented opportunity:** an officially listed programme, CCA, support resource or school arrangement.
- **Student-value interpretation:** a plain-language explanation of why a child with a particular interest might value that opportunity. This is an interpretation, not a measured outcome.
- **Documented constraint:** an explicit condition such as a campus move, a programme ending, selection requirements, off-site lessons or a published timetable.
- **Fit question:** something the family should assess, such as travel, comfort with the school’s ethos, time commitment or access to a desired activity. It is not an allegation about the school.

School websites describe intended culture and benefits. They do not by themselves establish teaching quality, mental-health outcomes, bullying prevalence or how every student experiences school. The file does not assign unsupported “good culture”, “high stress” or “weak support” ratings. The one included TKGS survey measure is explicitly school-reported, cohort-specific and missing a published sample size.

The common programme source is the [official MOE SchoolFinder directory](https://www.moe.gov.sg/schoolfinder/Secondary%20school), with each profile linked to its own entry. Selected school pages and publications add current detail. Complete generic CCA entries are retained; school-specific custom aliases are omitted where shared directory data can carry another school’s label. The dataset lists opportunities and access questions; it does not claim that every CCA or advanced programme has a place for every incoming student.

## 3. Research coverage

| Measure | Count |
|---|---:|
| Schools with student-fit profiles | 147 |
| Documented opportunity entries with student-value explanations | 292 |
| CCA offering records, preserving school and gender scope | 2648 |
| Schools with a CCA list | 145 |
| Schools with at least one documented practical constraint | 61 |
| O-Level school/year audit records | 294 |
| Year-specific numerical result metrics | 219 |
| Schools with at least one numerical result in either year | 20 |
| Schools with numerical evidence in both years | 11 |
| Distinct outcome source URLs checked | 738 |
| Distinct outcome search queries recorded | 300 |

CCA records are not a count of unique activities across Singapore and do not measure quality. SOTA’s arts specialisations and Sports School’s sports admission list are recorded separately from CCAs.

### Outcome evidence statuses

| Status | School/year slots | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| `verified_metrics` | 31 | Year-specific numerical outcomes found in the cited official source(s); inspect the metric’s cohort, definition and verification caveats. |
| `qualitative_only` | 34 | Official material describes achievements or congratulates the cohort, but no verified year-specific numerical outcome was extracted. |
| `release_notice_only` | 69 | Only collection/logistics or next-step information was established for that year; this is not a school performance result. |
| `not_found_in_checked_official_sources` | 127 | No usable year-specific outcome was located in the official sources checked. This does not prove that no publication exists. |
| `inaccessible_source` | 5 | A relevant source could not be retrieved or read sufficiently to verify an outcome. |
| `not_applicable_full_cohort` | 28 | A standard full-cohort O-Level comparison does not describe the school’s normal pathway. Individual subject or exceptional O-Level entries may still exist. |

### National context, with a consistent definition

| Examination year | Candidates | At least 1 subject at C6 or better | At least 3 subjects at C6 or better | At least 5 subjects at C6 or better |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2024 | 22,661 | 99.8% | 97.3% | 87.7% |
| 2025 | 22,468 | 99.8% | 96.8% | 86.9% |

Sources: [SEAB 2024](https://www.seab.gov.sg/newsroom/release-of-2024-singapore-cambridge-gce-o-level-exam-results/) and [SEAB 2025](https://www.seab.gov.sg/newsroom/release-of-2025-singapore-cambridge-gce-ordinary-level-examination-results/). These national figures are context, not an adjusted benchmark for a selectively admitted school or a single stream. A “pass rate” with an unspecified definition is not relabelled as the percentage with five C6 passes.

## 5. Verified numerical O-Level evidence

Each row retains its own cohort and definition. **Do not rank schools by mixing these rows.** An eligibility percentage is not a percentage actually admitted to that destination. Distinction counts are not pass rates. A subject result describes only pupils taking that subject. Named individual student results are not reproduced.

Where a historical official page survives only in an indexed retrieval, the metric/source audit records that limitation. Raw/net uncertainty is preserved; a figure is never silently converted to a raw L1R5, a net L1R5 or an average.

## 6. Student-fit profiles for all 147 schools

The opportunity explanations below are analyst interpretations of published provision. Practical constraints have their own sources. Questions are prompts for discussion, not verified disadvantages. Full source checks, metric definitions and search history are in the JSON.

### Admiralty Secondary School

**Woodlands · Government School · ID `sec-3072`**

Sources: [MOE profile](https://www.moe.gov.sg/schoolfinder/schooldetail/admiralty-secondary-school) · [School website](http://www.admiraltysec.moe.edu.sg)

**Admissions:** participates in ordinary S1 posting, subject to the school/programme and student’s eligibility.

**What you could gain beyond exam preparation**

- **TinkerTech:** You may enjoy this if you like trying coding, making or other new technologies. [Source](https://www.moe.gov.sg/schoolfinder/schooldetail/admiralty-secondary-school)
- **Nurturing Mindful Leaders through Community Outreach:** You may enjoy this if you like serving the community and practising leadership. [Source](https://www.moe.gov.sg/schoolfinder/schooldetail/admiralty-secondary-school)

**Practical considerations and fit questions**

- **Documented:** SchoolFinder states that Tamil lessons require attendance at a designated language centre after school. If you take Tamil, include this extra journey and lesson time when planning your week. [Source](https://www.moe.gov.sg/schoolfinder/schooldetail/admiralty-secondary-school)
- **Ask:** For TinkerTech, which activities are for everyone and which require selection? How much time will you spend on them?
- **Ask:** Can you join your preferred CCA as a beginner? Check trials, places, weekly sessions and the journey home after training.

**Listed CCAs** — availability and selection must be confirmed for the intended intake.

- **Club and societies:** Art and Crafts; Digital Media; Robotics.
- **Physical sports:** Badminton; Netball (girls); Rugby (boys); Track and Field; Wushu.
- **Uniformed groups:** National Cadet Corps (NCC) (Land); National Civil Defence Cadet Corps (NCDCC); National Police Cadet Corps (NPCC).
- **Visual and performing arts:** Concert Band; English Drama; Guzheng Ensemble; Modern Dance.

**Published DSA focus areas:** Community Youth Leadership; Concert Band; Guzheng Ensemble; National Civil Defence Cadet Corps (NCDCC); Netball; Robotics; Rugby; Stem; Track and Field; Wushu. These describe recruitment focus, not guaranteed access or measured performance; ordinary S1 applicants use the ordinary posting rules.

**Support resources:** Barrier-free accessibility; Special Educational Needs Officers. If you need support, ask about your individual needs, daily arrangements and who will support you; a listed resource does not establish staffing ratios or service quality.

**O-Level evidence**

- **2024: Not located**.
  No year-specific school-wide O-Level metric was verified in the checked official sources. This is a public-evidence gap, not a score of zero and not evidence of poor outcomes.
- **2025: Not located**.
  No year-specific school-wide O-Level metric was verified in the checked official sources. This is a public-evidence gap, not a score of zero and not evidence of poor outcomes.

**Admissions:** separate admission route; this school is not an ordinary six-choice S1 posting option. DSA and any supplementary intake; no ordinary S1-posting COP published.

**What you could gain beyond exam preparation**

- **Research and talent development:** Explore sustained mathematics and science inquiry alongside humanities and arts experiences. [Source](https://www.moe.gov.sg/schoolfinder/schooldetail/nus-high-school-of-mathematics-and-science)
- **Voyager and boarding:** Explore international perspectives and independence through the school’s development programmes. [Source](https://www.moe.gov.sg/schoolfinder/schooldetail/nus-high-school-of-mathematics-and-science)

**Practical considerations and fit questions**

- **Documented:** The school describes a compulsory one-year boarding stay in Year 5. Consider whether living away from home, the residential routine and applicable costs suit you; confirm future-cohort arrangements. [Source](https://www.nushigh.edu.sg/student-development/boarding-programme/boarding-objectives/)
- **Ask:** Which of the listed enrichment opportunities are available to all students in your route, and which require selection?
- **Ask:** Can you join your preferred CCA as a beginner? Check trials, places, weekly sessions and the journey home after training.
- **Ask:** Check the current school fees, financial assistance and costs of equipment, trips or boarding that apply to you.

**Listed CCAs** — availability and selection must be confirmed for the intended intake.

- **Club and societies:** Astronomy Club (gender scope not specified); Chess Club (gender scope not specified); Debate Club (gender scope not specified); Journalism Club (gender scope not specified); Media Club (gender scope not specified); Youth Flying Club (gender scope not specified).
- **Visual and performing arts:** Chinese Orchestra (gender scope not specified); High School Choir (gender scope not specified); Dance Club (gender scope not specified); Drama Club (gender scope not specified); School Orchestra (gender scope not specified).
- **Physical sports:** Badminton (gender scope not specified); Basketball (gender scope not specified); Football (gender scope not specified); Netball (gender scope not specified); Outdoor Adventure Club (gender scope not specified); Water Sports (gender scope not specified).
- **Uniformed groups:** NCC Land (gender scope not specified); St John Brigade (gender scope not specified).

**Published DSA focus areas:** Mathematics; Science. These describe recruitment focus, not guaranteed access or measured performance; ordinary S1 applicants use the ordinary posting rules.

**Support resources:** Not listed in the directory; ask the school directly. The directory did not list support resources. This is not evidence that support is absent; ask the school about your individual needs.

**O-Level evidence**

- **2024: Not a standard O-Level cohort**.
  The six-year curriculum culminates in the NUS High School Diploma, rather than a full O-Level examination. Some Mother Tongue/Higher Mother Tongue subject examinations may still be taken; these are not a full O-Level cohort.
- **2025: Not a standard O-Level cohort**.
  The six-year curriculum culminates in the NUS High School Diploma, rather than a full O-Level examination. Some Mother Tongue/Higher Mother Tongue subject examinations may still be taken; these are not a full O-Level cohort.

## 7. App implementation guidance

### Keep four different questions separate

1. **Can I apply through this route?** Use the existing posting-group, programme, affiliation and DSA rules. A historical cut-off does not determine formal eligibility.
2. **Would daily life suit me?** Match the child’s actual interests, support needs, travel tolerance, budget and preferred pathway to the documented opportunities and constraints.
3. **How do my scores compare with past postings?** Show both historical cut-offs and their annotations. Do not invent an admission probability.
4. **What outcomes has the school published?** Show exact result definitions, years, cohorts and evidence gaps. A missing publication is not a bad result, and a high outcome is not proof of a school’s causal effectiveness.

The old cut-off cohorts and the graduating O-Level cohorts are different groups. Neither a subtraction between their scores nor a ranking of their outcomes measures educational “value added”. Programme access also varies by route, selection and year. Do not automatically rank a school higher because it publishes more numbers or has a longer CCA list.

Historical “Secondary 4 Express” and “Secondary 5 Normal (Academic)” describe the former courses. They must not be relabelled as direct outcome predictions for today’s Posting Groups 3 and 2. Secondary 5 results describe the students who took that particular progression route, rather than all students who entered Normal (Academic).

For a child-facing screen, display the documented offering, a short “you might enjoy this if…” interpretation, and a “check before choosing” question. Let the student and family record their own preferences. Treat unknowns explicitly and allow an open-house or school-response note to resolve them with a date and source.

### Data structure

| Collection | Purpose | Key |
|---|---|---|
| `schools` | Same 147-school master directory | `school_id` |
| `cutoff_records` | All 899 original historical route/affiliation records | `record_id` |
| `primary_schools`, `affiliations` | Existing primary-school affiliation model | String IDs |
| `holistic_profiles` | Programmes, CCAs, support, interpretations, constraints and questions | `school_id` |
| `olevel_results_audit` | Exactly one explicit evidence-status record per school and exam year | `result_record_id` |
| `olevel_metrics` | Numerical facts with complete source/cohort definitions | `metric_id` |
| `olevel_school_notes` | Route exceptions and any undated or non-comparable statements | `school_id` |
| `olevel_national_context` | Consistently defined national outcomes | `exam_year` |
| `sources` | Named national, policy and selected programme sources | `source_id` |

The result audit links to metrics through `metric_ids`. A source URL is also kept on every numerical metric. `denominator: null`, unspecified raw/net status and missing cohort splits remain unknown. Percentage values use the 0–100 scale. Never replace a missing value with zero.

`comparison_operator` qualifies the published value: for example `>` plus `94` means **more than 94%**, and `approximately` plus `83` means **about 83%**. This differs from an outcome threshold such as “at least five distinctions”; preserve both the metric definition and any value qualifier. `result_scope` uses `subject_cohort` for subject-level results and `published_cohort_or_achievement_measure` for other published measures. `provenance_flags` expose indexed historical evidence, temporal inference and known source inconsistencies.

The additions are schema **1.1.0**. Existing school IDs, all original cut-off records, primary-school links and affiliation records are preserved. Maris Stella’s Secondary 1 gender field has been independently verified as boys using the current official rebuilding notice. Names, moves and future aliases do not change the school ID.

### Import the canonical data

The Markdown is a container for the database. Use the JSON block below as the single import source; do not attempt to parse the display tables into a second database.

```javascript
const match = markdownText.match(
  /<!-- BEGIN_APP_DATA -->\s*```json\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*```\s*<!-- END_APP_DATA -->/
);
if (!match) throw new Error("Embedded school database not found");
const db = JSON.parse(match[1]);
if (db.schema_version !== "1.1.0") throw new Error("Unsupported schema");
const profiles = new Map(db.holistic_profiles.map(p => [p.school_id, p]));
const metrics = new Map(db.olevel_metrics.map(m => [m.metric_id, m]));
// Keep school/programme codes as strings. A missing result is not zero.
```

### Updating and verifying

Update the intended intake and research date explicitly. Recheck programmes, fees, transport and any relocation before the next admissions cycle. Append a new examination year only after results are released and its year is unambiguous. Retain the original definition and source version where an official page is overwritten.

Validation performed for this version: all 147 school IDs match the prior database; all 294 school/year slots are present and unique; numerical metrics have sources and cohort labels; percentages fall in the 0–100 range; all 899 cut-off records and 39 affiliation links are unchanged; and the Markdown-embedded JSON round-trips without loss. These checks validate data structure and preservation, not unpublished facts.

  "posting_group_guidance": {
    "source_id": "moe_posting_groups",
    "bands": [
      {
        "min_al": 4,
        "max_al": 20,
        "eligible_groups": [
          3
        ],
        "extra_condition": null
      },
      {
        "min_al": 21,
        "max_al": 22,
        "eligible_groups": [
          2,
          3
        ],
        "extra_condition": "Choose one group for all school choices."
      },
      {
        "min_al": 23,
        "max_al": 24,
        "eligible_groups": [
          2
        ],
        "extra_condition": null
      },
      {
        "min_al": 25,
        "max_al": 25,
        "eligible_groups": [
          1,
          2
        ],
        "extra_condition": "Choose one group for all school choices."
      },
      {
        "min_al": 26,
        "max_al": 30,
        "eligible_groups": [
          1
        ],
        "extra_condition": "AL7 or better in both English Language and Mathematics."
      }
    ],
    "use_actual_moe_eligibility_when_available": true
  },
  "application_rules": [
    {
      "rule_id": "year_labels",
      "kind": "source_interpretation",
      "text": "Posting year is the PSLE/S1 posting exercise year. S1 entry occurs the following year. The 2024 and 2025 values are historical inputs for planning 2027 entry, not confirmed 2027 cut-offs.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_schoolfinder",
        "seab_2026_release"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "up_to_six",
      "kind": "official_policy",
      "text": "A student may submit up to six school/programme choices. Encourage use of all six where suitable, without labelling six as a mandatory minimum.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_school_choices",
        "seab_2026_release"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "one_posting_group",
      "kind": "official_policy",
      "text": "For an option-band student, one selected Posting Group applies to all submitted choices. Do not mix PG2 and PG3, or PG1 and PG2, within one submitted list.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_school_choices"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "history_not_eligibility",
      "kind": "app_design",
      "text": "Use current official admission eligibility to determine selectable schools. A score worse than a historical COP is a comparison result, not a reason by itself to prohibit selecting the school. Historical data does not supply admission probabilities.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_score_ranges",
        "moe_posting_works"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "separate_programme_choices",
      "kind": "official_policy",
      "text": "At a dual-track school, IP and SEC are separate choices with different programme choice codes. Retain both routes. When validating duplicates, use selected Posting Group plus programme choice code, rather than school identity alone.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_posting_works",
        "moe_schoolfinder"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "affiliation_position",
      "kind": "official_policy",
      "text": "Apply affiliated comparisons only when the pupil has the qualifying primary-school affiliation, meets any additional criteria and uses the required choice order. Normally the school must be first. The same dual-track school IP first and SEC second preserves SEC affiliation priority.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_posting_works"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "affiliated_ip",
      "kind": "source_interpretation",
      "text": "The six dual-track affiliated IP placeholders mean affiliation is inapplicable. Nanyang Girls has an actual affiliated IP range. Use the records and rule context instead of a universal IP-affiliation assumption.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_posting_works",
        "moe_schoolfinder"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "hcl_priority",
      "kind": "official_policy",
      "text": "At SAP schools, Higher Chinese priority applies to students with PSLE total 14 or better and a qualifying D, M or P grade, among students with the same total. Better total scores come first. The HCL priority order is D, M, P, then no qualifying HCL grade. Do not apply HCL priority above total 14 or convert HCL grades into AL bonus points. Preserve unknown student HCL status separately from no qualifying grade.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_posting_works"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "sap_subjects",
      "kind": "official_policy",
      "text": "Verify current SAP admission conditions, including having taken English and Chinese at PSLE. HCL is not itself compulsory for SAP application; qualifying HCL priority applies for eligible scores.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_posting_works"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "ties",
      "kind": "official_policy",
      "text": "After the applicable score and HCL considerations, ordinary tie-breakers are citizenship, choice order and computerised balloting. Matching a historical COP is not guaranteed admission.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_posting_works",
        "moe_score_ranges"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "dsa_allocated",
      "kind": "official_policy",
      "text": "A student successfully allocated to a school through DSA-Sec does not submit ordinary S1 school choices. Distinguish successful allocation from merely having made a DSA application or received an earlier offer.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_school_choices"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "historical_buffer",
      "kind": "app_design",
      "text": "When both years contain numeric COPs for the relevant route and affiliation, an optional two-year AL buffer is min(COP2024, COP2025) minus the student AL total. A positive number means a better total than both published COPs. Preserve HCL and vacancy flags separately. With either year absent, return null rather than a made-up two-year buffer.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_score_ranges",
        "seab_2026_release"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "choice_balance",
      "kind": "official_guidance",
      "text": "Encourage at least two to three choices whose historical COPs are less stringent than the student score. Describe a positive historical buffer accurately; avoid guaranteed-admission or probability labels derived from two cut-offs.",
      "source_ids": [
        "seab_2026_release"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "preference_order",
      "kind": "app_design",
      "text": "Help the family order eligible choices by genuine preference, including curriculum fit, interests and travel. Recalculate the applicable affiliation category when choices are reordered. Do not silently sort the final list solely by COP.",
      "source_ids": [
        "moe_posting_works",
        "seab_2026_release"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "exam_year_is_not_release_year",
      "kind": "source_interpretation",
      "text": "The latest two released O-Level examination cohorts as of 24 November 2026 are 2024 and 2025, released in January 2025 and January 2026. Do not relabel January 2026 results as the 2026 examination cohort.",
      "source_ids": [
        "seab_2024_olevel_results",
        "seab_2025_olevel_results",
        "seab_2026_exam_dates"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "sec_future_pathway",
      "kind": "official_policy",
      "text": "The SEC replaces N(T), N(A) and O-Level qualifications from 2027. Historical O-Level outcomes provide context for a 2027 entrant; they do not predict that child’s eventual SEC results. IP and specialised routes must be described separately.",
      "source_ids": [
        "seab_sec_certificate"
      ]
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "missing_is_not_zero",
      "kind": "app_design",
      "text": "Display an explicit result status for every school/year. Null or absent results must never become zero, a fail, a poor-school label or a negative score.",
      "source_ids": []
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "match_metric_definitions",
      "kind": "app_design",
      "text": "Compare only like examination year, cohort, metric, threshold, aggregation and raw/net definition. Five passes, five distinctions, JC eligibility, JC/MI eligibility, poly eligibility and eligibility for any post-secondary institution are different measures.",
      "source_ids": []
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "school_results_not_value_added",
      "kind": "analytical_limit",
      "text": "Published outcomes mix incoming student differences, cohort composition and many other influences. They do not estimate a school’s causal contribution. The cut-off and O-Level cohorts in this file are also different groups of students.",
      "source_ids": []
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "opportunity_is_not_guaranteed_access",
      "kind": "app_design",
      "text": "Show a programme or CCA as a documented opportunity. Show selection, route, gender, year, capacity and timetable limitations separately; never promise a place from a directory entry.",
      "source_ids": []
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "keep_evidence_and_fit_separate",
      "kind": "app_design",
      "text": "Present the published fact, the student-value interpretation and the family’s own fit assessment as separate fields. A long programme list is not a quality score.",
      "source_ids": []
    },
    {
      "rule_id": "campus_changes_and_aliases",
      "kind": "app_design",
